events.text: The shared :8791 runner rejects our key, so I'm starting a private runner on :8931 and restarting the private stack.

events.input: $ cd /tmp/t299 && python3 - <<'EOF'

events.name: Bash

events.input: $ for i in $(seq 1 40); do a=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -m2 http://127.0.0.1:8930/); b=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -m2 http://127.0.0.1:8934/); c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -m2 http://127.0.0.1:8932/); [ "$a" != 000 ] && [ "$b" != 000 ] && [ "$c" != 000 ] && break; sleep 3; done; echo "$a $b $c"; K=$(grep '^RUNNER_KEY=' /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud/.dev.vars | cut -d= -f2); curl -s -m5 -X POST -H "x-runner-key: $K" -d '{}' http://127.0.0.1:8931/; echo; curl -s -m3 http://127.0.0.1:8932/cloudflare/__latest | head -c 200
